reserves.name: GBP cash and short-term UK gilts
reserves.issuerOrObligor: BCP Technologies Ltd reserve accounts at regulated UK banking partners; UK government gilt exposure

reserveReview.rationale: BCP Technologies states that every tGBP is backed one-for-one by cash and short-term UK gilts. No current asset-class weights are published, so the composition is represented as one aggregate basket without inventing a cash/gilt split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Tokenised GBP issuer disclosure; asset-class weights undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer discloses the complete eligible reserve basket but not the current allocation between GBP cash and short-term UK gilts.

nonLinkDispositions.reserveName: GBP cash and short-term UK gilts
nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer does not publish the current cash/gilt weights.

providers.name: Reserve banks and securities custodian (not publicly disclosed)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed issuer disclosure does not identify reserve banks or a securities custodian, publish provider shares, or establish segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, and rehypothecation safeguards.
